# Frozen schema v3 fixtures

Generated with the unmodified v3 implementation from `b882029` (0.1.9), before
any schema changes. Synthetic text and deterministic generated PNGs only.

`state.json` + `media/` contain: a formal record with three photos, a formal
record with an active edit draft and draft-only photo, a pure draft, a trashed
formal record, two tags, a favorite, and a deletion marker. Existing v3 captions
are deliberately nonempty to prove migration preserves them. Array order is the
original photo order.

`plain.sgbak` and `encrypted.sgbak` were exported by the same v3 Store. Encryption
uses the production Argon2id parameters (64 MiB, 3 iterations, 1 lane), a random
salt and nonce, and the test-only passphrase `synthetic-fixture-pass`. This is
synthetic fixture data, never a user credential. Random encrypted bytes are
intentionally frozen and must not be regenerated by a newer schema.

Reproduction on the original v3 core:

```sh
cargo test --offline --locked -p shiguang_core --test v3_golden_generator generate_v3_golden_fixtures -- --ignored --exact
```

The ignored generator guards `CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION == 3`. The regular fixture
test verifies both containers and checks the archived schema without rewriting
the files. New compatibility tests must consume these frozen bytes directly.
